request.question: How does flowspace3 prevent two concurrent workers from claiming the same queued job?

ground_truth.search_query: what invariant prevents two workers from claiming the same queued job
ground_truth.resolution: Both addresses returned ok=true via flowspace3 get; spans were [168,203] and [625,660].
source_facts: claim_jobs performs one UPDATE whose subquery locks candidates with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED before returning them.
The update atomically moves selected jobs to running and increments attempts.
The concurrency test asserts distinct job ids and that a third claimant sees no pending job.
